entities.name: Konstantinos Harmenopoulos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Constantine Harmenopoulos was a Byzantine jurist of Armenian descent who held the post of katholikos kritēs of Thessalonica, one of the highest judicial offices in the Byzantine Empire.
